label: Boston Public Schools district
note: Charters in separate districts are not included solely because they are located in Boston.

label: Eligible school
note: Positive matched 2024-25 grade-12 enrollment in the existing merged sample.

label: Low-income-share tercile
note: 1 = higher, 2 = middle, 3 = lower share. Fixed across all outcomes from 407 eligible schools.

label: Low-income-share quartile
note: 1 = highest and 4 = lowest share. Fixed statewide groups.

label: Screened school FAFSA estimate
note: 2025-26 aid cycle completions through May 31, 2025 / October 2024 grade-12 enrollment. Historical May 2026 FSA release. Not roster matched.

label: FAFSA availability status
note: Missing and suppressed are never zero; over100 ratios and unresolved multiple records are excluded from usable estimates.

label: Enrolled seniors
note: October 2024 school grade-12 count; different from four-year graduation cohort.

label: Estimated four-year college attendance
note: Exact Stage 06 derivation from rounded source rates; Class of 2025 by March 2026.

label: Severe chronic absence
note: 2024-25 whole-school students missing at least 20% of membership days.

label: Chronic absence
note: 2024-25 whole-school students missing at least 10% of membership days.

label: Four-year graduation
note: 2025 four-year graduation cohort, not current enrolled seniors.

label: AP exams scoring 3-5
note: 2024-25 exams, not percentage of students; students can take multiple exams.

label: Campus-tract median household income
note: Exploratory campus context. ACS vintage/geocoding are unverified. Multicampus values average tract medians. Not student household income.

label: Additional school outcomes
source: Original DTA plus exact Stage 06 derived formulas and source gates
note: 33 outcomes; population, units and restrictions differ. Null indicates unavailable under the source gate.
